apps.name: AKASHA
apps.short_description: AKASHA is a personal archive for the works you love. Keep posters, ratings, reviews and diaries as Markdown files on your own PC, and let an AI agent help you record them.

apps.name: Cable Guardian
apps.short_description: Prevent cable twisting effortlessly! Cable Guardian keeps track of your rotation in VR and lets you know when to turn the other way. Forget the cable and focus on the fun!

apps.name: Callipeg Studio
apps.short_description:
Animate anywhere.
Simple and lightweight professional 2D animation software for beginners and professionals, made for frame-by-frame and keyframe animation.

apps.name: Casual Game Engine
apps.short_description: Casual Game Engine is a free game engine to let users create their own 2D top-down singleplayer shooter games.

apps.name: CeBo Translator
apps.short_description: Shows the English menus, quests, dialogue and subtitles of your games in Turkish, right where they appear on screen. Reads only the screen: no game files touched, no patch to wait for. Offline translation built in, DeepL optional. Translate the whole screen or just the areas you pick.

apps.name: CO-OP Comms
apps.short_description: Tired of always playing the game with one ear off? CO-OP Comms plays one microphone in both headsets over your wired home network, so two people on two PCs can talk mid-game without lifting an earcup. Only the host pays. The other PC's copy is free.

apps.name: DeskDash: Desktop Widgets
apps.short_description: DeskDash puts live, interactive widgets on your Windows desktop background. Launch apps and games from a shelf, tick off your tasks, control your music and watch your PC, right on the wallpaper. Swap the Windows taskbar for a dock, and add more widgets free from the built-in marketplace.

apps.name: GrindMaster: Auto Clicker
apps.short_description: GrindMaster is a functional Auto Clicker and input utility built for Steam players. It handles repetitive clicking and complex key sequences through hardware-level simulation, helping you manage in-game loops while reducing hand strain during long sessions. Simple, lightweight, and game-ready.

apps.name: Gripspeak
apps.short_description: Voice typing for the Steam Frame. Hold both grips, say it, let go: Gripspeak types it into Steam chat, the browser, the terminal or any desktop app. Speech recognition runs on the headset, so your voice never leaves it and it works offline. Requires a Steam Frame.

apps.name: Layernet Note
apps.short_description: A local note-taking and knowledge management tool. Break knowledge into layers, then connect them.Follow one point to uncover its connected context. Find similar content to compare and combine ideas. See words and images together at a glance. Adjust layout to build a clear mental map over time.

apps.name: LessPrep
apps.short_description: Create custom worksheets, coloring pages, visual supports, and classroom materials with a flexible page editor.

apps.name: MCCP
apps.short_description: Play your console on your PC through a USB capture card, with as little delay as possible and the sound passed straight through. Ctrl+Tab opens an overlay over the game, and Lua mods add what you need: stat panels, notes, screenshots, picture shaders and more.

apps.name: MMDEngine
apps.short_description: A cute girl jumped into your computer . She sits on your taskbar, dances to your music, and hides at the screen's edge till you find her. Soon she's the first thing you check for.

apps.name: Never Ending Dungeon
apps.short_description: Never Ending Dungeon is AI-powered software to adventures creation for Tabletop RPGs. Less prep, more play. A huge time saver for DMs and Players!

apps.name: NOODS Maker
apps.short_description: Have you ever wanted a personalized desktop companion? Look no further than NOODS Maker, a way to upload your own art and animations to make desktop pets. Want a magical creature or your worst enemy trapped on your screen? Then make it! Afterwards, share and sell your “NOODS” on the world wide web.

apps.name: NotiVR
apps.short_description: Stop lifting your headset! NotiVR shows your iPhone or Android notifications in SteamVR. Stay connected and never miss a message again.

apps.name: Onmal
apps.short_description: A free Windows app that turns teammates' voice chat and game dialogue into translated subtitles on your PC. Playtest 0.1.0 adds keep-on mode and optional Steam voice rooms. Real-game quality and calls between two PCs are still being verified.

apps.name: PC Master Aim
apps.short_description: PC Master Aim allows you to customize your crosshairs, offering a diverse range of pre-designed options and the ability to create new ones, tailoring each to perfectly match your preferences. Additionally, it offers an Aim Trainer to further enhance your aiming skills.

apps.name: PhonePlay
apps.short_description: Play any Android game on PC with a controller, mouse, and keyboard. No emulator. No phone app. One permission. Connect by USB, drop buttons onto a screenshot of your phone, save a profile, and play. Setup in under 60 seconds.

apps.name: Pngify.me
apps.short_description: Basic Pngtuber app with a ton of interactivity features from twitch

apps.name: ScagJPT
apps.short_description:
ScagJPT is a useful and fun Desktop pet for all of your scagalicious needs.
She will sit on your desktop for anytime you'd like to display a video/gif, use her pomodoro timer, or any time you'd like to launch her around your desktop!

apps.name: Shoji Flow
apps.short_description: An intelligent window manager for Windows. Save your window setups for gaming, streaming, coding or work and bring them back with one hotkey: Shoji Flow moves your windows into place across your monitors, launches missing apps and learns your routines to suggest new layouts.

apps.name: Shortcut Manager
apps.short_description: Organize apps, games, websites, files, and folders into custom workspaces. Open anything in seconds with Command Center and Quick Wheel, save what you copy with Quick Capture, and automate your setup with built-in Windows controls.

apps.name: Simple Sight - Crosshair Overlay
apps.short_description: Simple Sight is a minimal and user-friendly app designed to overlay custom crosshairs on any game of your choice. Customize their look, load them from your library and switch between them with ease.

apps.name: SplitFire AI
apps.short_description: Split any song into vocals, drums, bass and more. The separation runs on your computer, so your audio is not uploaded anywhere. Pick a file, choose a model and press Separate.

apps.name: TurnSignal
apps.short_description: A minimalistic, intuitive, visual, IN-GAME utility for keeping track of Cord Wrapping/Tangling in SteamVR!

apps.name: upeum
apps.short_description: upeum is a free drawing app with practice built in. Draw with pressure-sensitive brushes and layers, and warm up with line, circle and box exercises scored stroke by stroke on the same canvas. Pose 3D backdrops right on your drawing, keep references beside it, and open and save PSD.

apps.name: Wallpets
apps.short_description: Bring cinematic animated cats, dogs and other companions to your Windows desktop. Explore the entire public catalog for free, or turn your own pet into a Wallpet in Custom Lab with a one-time purchase for each custom pet. No subscription.

apps.name: Yap: The VR Dictation Keyboard
apps.short_description: Yap brings speech-to-text directly into your VR experience. Speak naturally and watch your words appear in any application, right from VR! Ditch those clunky VR keyboards and Yap naturally!

Agent Pigeon 7 Demo
apps.short_description: Shoot your way through endless waves of government drones! Grab loot, level up, unlock pigeons and upgrade to create unique and crazy builds as you fend off mindless government of creatures.

apps.name: Aim Assault Demo
apps.short_description: Aim Assault brings classic arcade shooters into the world of virtual reality. Dodge a storm of bullets, take down hordes of enemies, and save the world. Try it now for free.

apps.name: Amadeus: A Riddle for Thee ~ Episode 2 ~ Reharm Demo
BACKUP_71 Demo
apps.short_description: A psychological horror investigation and survival game where you explore a house full of secrets, faces the living unkow, solve puzzles, use a fully interactive retro computer, and uncover a decades-old conspiracy.

apps.name: Bastion Heart Demo
apps.short_description: A tactical tower defense where you can freeze time to reposition units mid-battle, gear them up with items, enhance them with skill trees, and unleash powerful abilities to clear massive waves of enemies and challenging bosses!

apps.name: Bayaya Demo
apps.short_description: Bayaya is a folk-tale inspired, non-violent adventure combining 3D RPG and point-and-click mechanics. Explore a vast, procedurally generated world, take on various tasks, and experience a unique wooden toy aesthetic.

apps.name: Bee Space Demo
apps.short_description: Plant flowers and deploy tech from orbit in this roguelike deckbuilder! Terraform tiny hex grid islands as advanced space Bees. Contend with fickle weather, strange creatures, mysterious artifacts and meddling bosses as you reclaim Earth for all Bee-Kind!

apps.name: Bio Inc. Total Defense Demo
apps.short_description: Bio Inc. Total Defense is an incremental tower defense game set inside your body. Command your immune system against massive hordes of viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens. Upgrade your defenses, place them wisely, and fight for every inch of your body.

apps.name: Bloody Handy Demo
apps.short_description: Get BLOODY HANDY with friends in this comedy-horror co-op demo for up to 6 players. Search for a list of objects, but each one is dangerous to hold for too long. Pass the parcel along to the exit before they poison, zap or explode you. Don't drop any items, as monsters are also on the hunt!

apps.name: Blosharper Demo
apps.short_description: Blosharper is a card-shark noir roguelike deckbuilder: forge Korean Hwatu card combos to smash each round's target score. Don't rely on luck—use illicit "cheat" skills to rig the deck and survive a deadly underground gambling den. Pay off your debt, defeat the bosses, become the ultimate sharp!

apps.name: Brokie Demo
apps.short_description: Play the prologue and your first two weeks back from rock bottom. Start over with $3,000 in a share house, work part-time jobs, read the news and rumors, and make your first trades. In the full game, your comeback continues for a whole year.

apps.name: Bush League Baseball Demo
apps.short_description: Play ball at The Palace. One free exhibition, the Mudcats at the Regents, in full 3D with bobblehead ballplayers, a royal grandstand and Chuck Baseball in the booth, delighted by every error. Real rules, terrible players, three to nine innings.

apps.name: Capyverse Odyssey Demo
apps.short_description: Jump into a fast-paced co-op action roguelite! Battle through chaotic worlds, complete objectives, wield ridiculous weapons, stack powerful upgrades, and take on challenging bosses with a friend.

apps.name: Catechesis Demo
apps.short_description: Begin the story of Catechesis: meet the main characters, explore the first dungeons, and face demons in an intense one-hour gameplay.

apps.name: Catnip Wars : Nine Lives Racing Demo
Cats & Rhythmical Restaurant Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy cat restaurant that lives on your desktop and comes alive to whatever you're listening to. While sound plays, your cats head out for fish, cook, and serve hungry guests; when it's quiet, they get bored and doze off. Recruit cats, dress them up, and grow your seaside diner.

apps.name: Chad Billionaire Demo
apps.short_description: Start broke. Work terrible jobs. Put that cash to work in real estate, businesses, and acquisitions until you hit your first million. That's where Chad Millionaire ends and Chad Billionaire begins. Your save carries over. The numbers are exaggerated. The financial logic underneath them isn't.

apps.name: CHERONIA Demo
apps.short_description: Survive a ravine, search a decaying fortress, and reach the edge of CHERONIA. A horror RPG demo with turn-based combat, environmental puzzles, scarce supplies, and Cherons that restore health at a dangerous cost.

apps.name: Coalateral Damage Demo
apps.short_description: A hands-on mining management roguelite. Dig coal, haul it to the belt and beat the shift clock while keeping up with repairs. Purchase machines, upgrades and a crew. The quota climbs, and so does your debt, and the mine fights back with cave-ins, rats, thieves and worse. Play the demo now!

apps.name: Cosa Nostra – The Dark Empire Demo
COTTON Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy isometric sim about running a 1980s cotton farm out bush. Pump the water, plant and chip the paddocks, fly the duster and get the pickers in. Play the manager, or borrow the soul of anyone on the place, from the mechanic to the school bus driver. Ride out the floods and beat the bell.

apps.name: Cozy Beach Demo
apps.short_description: 🏝️ Cozy Beach is a wholesome game set on a tropical beach where you can fish and explore, solo or with friends. Pick out your fave kitty, catch and collect fish, explore Paw Print Island, and hang out and chill!

apps.name: Crack a Pack Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental collectathon. Crack packs till you complete your collection. Sacrifice cards for upgrades, hire pawns, and swim in money. One question remains: Can you crack 'em all?

apps.name: Crazy Farm 瘋碰農場 Demo
apps.short_description: A relaxing yet chaotic farming roguelike. Combine quirky animals, items, and strategic layouts to create explosive, poop-powered chain reactions!

apps.name: Creator's Asteroid Demo
apps.short_description: A tile-based Metroidvania maker! Design and playtest your mini-world in this demo version.

apps.name: CRIMSON PANDEMIC Demo
apps.short_description: CRIMSON PANDEMIC: A tale of the 'Rubrum'—a crimson light that mutates living beings into entities driven by resentment—and 'Belle,' a girl who has lost her dreams, embarking on a journey of promise aboard a Ark.

apps.name: Crown Siege Demo
apps.short_description: A short incremental tower defense game centered around growing and strengthening armies, to defend your kingdom and stop endless waves of enemies.

apps.name: Cup and Counter: Coffee Shop Simulator Demo
Cursemark Demo
apps.short_description: Hack, slash, and cast your way through a haunted kingdom brimming with secrets where no two builds are ever the same. As a cursed mage-knight you will unlock devastating spells, equip ability transforming runes, and reforge your curse on the path to victory or death in this fantasy action roguelite.

apps.name: Decktamer Demo
apps.short_description: Deck-building meets monster catching in this turn-based roguelike. Recruit enemy cards to your party as you dive into the depths of the abyss. Will you kill them or will you tame them?

apps.name: Deepfold: One Day Deep Demo
apps.short_description: The demo for Deepfold: One Day Deep. Play from the Prologue through Chapter 3 and read seven letters. On the same PC, your demo save carries straight into the full game.

apps.name: Desk Quest Demo
apps.short_description: Try Desk Quest, an idle ARPG that lives in a thin strip above your Windows taskbar. Raise adventurers who fight, loot and choose for themselves, walk Oathwood Trail and Mistbound Watch, and earn your first class promotion. About 75 minutes.

apps.name: Die First Demo
apps.short_description: Die First is a casual, physics-based party game where the first player dead wins! Run, jump, dash, and use items or map hazards to destroy yourself while saving your opponents. Supports 4 players in online or local play. WARNING: Contains excessive cartoon violence and friendship-ruining mechanics.

apps.name: Digital Hunger Demo
apps.short_description: Digital Hunger is a first-person investigation horror game You've seized the personal computer of a serial killer known only as "Blackbeard" Dig through his files, photos, emails and hidden folders crack his passwords and follow the trail across a haunting recreation of the late 90s Israeli internet

apps.name: Don’t Pull Me! Demo
apps.short_description: Dont Pull Me is a physics-based co-op parkour game for 1 to 4 players. Tied together by a rope, you and your friends must climb, swing, carry objects, and survive chaotic ragdoll disasters without dragging the whole team down.

apps.name: Dragon's Tear Demo
apps.short_description: Slay monsters, harvest their Tears and power-up your party in this idle dungeon crawler RPG. Farm cleared floors while AFK, then leap back into action to lead your party down 100 handcrafted floors. Can you find the legendary Dragon's Tear?

apps.name: Drain It All Demo
apps.short_description: Drain a 10,000-ton dam, starting with a paper cup. Sell water, buy pumps, build a filtering and bottling plant, and find out what is at the bottom of the dam. A first-person incremental game about one extremely bad plan.

apps.name: Dustronauts Demo
apps.short_description: Clean up dusty alien worlds alone or with up to 16 players in this relaxing space cleaning simulator! Vacuum endless dust, upgrade your equipment, automate your operations, and build your own space cleaning empire with friends.

apps.name: DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS Demo
apps.short_description: In this demo version of "DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS", you can experience a new side of the "Battle of Sishui Gate"!

apps.name: Dyping Escape Demo
apps.short_description: "Let's play a typing game." Dyping Escape is a simple game where you type according to instructions from the game master, a mysterious eyeball. But be careful; everything you type becomes reality. Just be careful not to brick your computer.

apps.name: Elysian Realms Demo
apps.short_description: The first realm of Elysian Realms, free. Frosthold, all three eras, with the skill tree and the Mercantile. A pixel-art tower defense where every run, won or lost, makes the next one stronger. The full game has seven realms, and the road does not end.

apps.name: Enoch Demo
apps.short_description: A murder investigation. Teenagers vanishing for years. On Enoch Space Station, detectives, suspects, and killers each follow their own path, only to uncover a conspiracy that has been hiding in plain sight for generations. A sci-fi noir point-and-click adventure.

apps.name: Eternal Knight Demo
apps.short_description:
Demo featuring a subset of the first release of Eternal Knight coming in 2025.

A Souls-like, player vs. environment medieval, survival horror game with a high level of difficulty, a world and creatures set in dark fantasy, and a story told through environmental storytelling.

apps.name: Forsakia Demo
apps.short_description: You're a bounty hunter working off a depot's job board: fly into zones held by armed contractors, slip past or break their patrols, loot what you can carry, and hold an extraction zone until the helicopter takes you home.

apps.name: Fragile Frontier Demo
apps.short_description: A cold, quiet co-op delivery game for 1-2 owls sharing one old kei truck on a snowbound island. Play the first five deliveries: the driver can't read the paper map while moving, so the navigator does. Keep warm, rested and fuelled, and walk out into the fog for every parcel you spill.

apps.name: Fruit Kombat Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of the viral brain-rot fruit novela turned chaotic 3D fighting game. Four fruit brawlers, a guided tutorial that teaches every move, offline duel and four-fruit deathmatch, plus online rooms for your friends. Farm aura and unleash weapon ultimates.

apps.name: G.D.F. PHALANX: Missile Defense Protocol Demo
GNAW Demo
apps.short_description: Something’s rotten in New Dino City, and it’s up to you to solve the mystery in GNAW. In this metroidvania, explore a pre-apocalyptic saurian civilization hurtling toward self-annihilation. Meet strange characters, fight off twisted critters, and rescue your beloved city from extinction.

apps.name: Gold and Graves Demo
apps.short_description: Gold and Graves is a roguelike extraction game where you bribe enemies to recruit them as allies, escape the dungeon, and bring back cards, relics, and mercenaries to your village to accumulate resources. Strengthen your deck and forces with the resources you gather and challenge deeper dungeons.

apps.name: Gravity Strikers Demo
apps.short_description: Gravity Strikers is a team-based PvP sports game! Build your squad of champions, master aerial movement, combine shots and passes to control the ball, eliminate your rivals, and score together the goals that lead your team to victory!

apps.name: Guate Grand Prix Demo: Early Preview
apps.short_description: Play the first chapter of Guate Grand Prix: a single-player arcade racing demo with customizable wooden toy trucks and tracks inspired by Guatemala, its streets, landscapes, traditions, and playful local identity.

apps.name: HAMSTER: CLAW Demo
apps.short_description: Play the first ten floors of HAMSTER: CLAW, a single-player hack-and-slash ARPG. Crush insect swarms with growing elemental skills, shape your build with loot and runes, and climb the giant tree up to the floor 10 boss in this free demo.

apps.name: Handgun Football Demo
apps.short_description: Handgun Football Demo shatters physics: FPS meets soccer brawl. Revolvers, shotguns blast the ball into rival goals. Solo vs AI, slide from chill to hell; LAN or global 2 teams,up to 12 players.More modes will be unlocked in the full version.

apps.name: Hunt or be Haunted Demo
apps.short_description: Step into Hollow Creek Bungalow and find out what’s haunting it before it finds you. Team up with friends, gather evidence and name the ghost: a Shadow Man, a Banshee or a Remnant. Beat the demo challenge to earn rewards you keep for the full game.

apps.name: If You Flip a Bear: A Hangul Puzzle Demo
INDUSTRIA 2 Demo
apps.short_description: Explore, scavenge and fight your way through a mysterious landscape consumed by an ever-hungry artificial intelligence to find a way home in this demo for INDUSTRIA 2, a narrative FPS adventure about a woman stranded in a parallel dimension.

apps.name: InOut Demo
apps.short_description: A minimalist puzzle platformer where each level is more than they seem. Change your perspective on levels to discover new areas. Explore the world to unearth its hidden secrets.

apps.name: Jacmena Demo
apps.short_description: “Tin bòta, Jacmena!” A strange little girl always out of place and with a special power befriends the old keeper of a cemetery. Experience the story of Jacmena and Zvan in this hand drawn point-and-click adventure that draws inspiration from the legends and traditions of Romagna folklore.

apps.name: Jumbling Raccoons: Demo
apps.short_description: A chaotic raccoon adventure where you can build your treehouse in story-driven expeditions or jump into wild party mini-games. Play solo or with up to 3 friends online.

apps.name: Kalit Demo
apps.short_description: A unique survival adventure, animated in a 1930s rubber hose style! Fight to survive: capture creatures, farm, mine, and craft everything you need: from gear and vehicles to your base. Explore strange lands and an underwater world of shipwrecks, dangers, and hidden wonders.

apps.name: Kingdom Courier Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of Kingdom Courier. Carry the King’s mail across a kingdom that remembers you: plan routes over a hex map, act on rumors only as good as the village that told you, and choose between the villages who feed you and the crown who pays you.

apps.name: Kingdoms Assemble Demo
apps.short_description: Kingdoms Assemble is a fantasy async PvP auto-battler. Start from a small plot: buy tiles, plan your layout, expand territory, and conquer kingdoms on the world map. Your pre-arranged lineup automatically produces and strengthens your army. Forge a unique war kingdom and conquer the continent!

apps.name: Knit Knit Tidy Up Together Demo
LAMINA BRUISE Demo
apps.short_description: LAMINA BRUISE is a narrative-driven, first-person adventure set in a surreal sci-fi world. A tense yet meditative experience, paced by thoughtful puzzles. Play the demo for an introduction to the story and mechanics.

apps.name: Last Salaryman: Survival Idle RPG Demo
apps.short_description: The day the outbreak hit, your salaryman was finally free of work. Keep the game beside your taskbar: he explores the fallen city and scavenges gear and supplies. Mix weapons, attachments and talents into your own build, upgrade your hideout, and team up online with friends to explore together.

apps.name: LvL50 Demo
apps.short_description: KILL. DIE. LEARN. LvL50 is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you need to beat 50 levels, in a row, without getting hit. Can you become a master and escape the lab?

apps.name: Magitech Mecha: Requiem of the Azure Flame Demo
apps.short_description: A philosophical, character-driven sci-fi adventure blending visual novel storytelling, dungeon exploration, and turn-based combat. Play as Adrian, a legendary mercenary. Pilot a Mana Mecha into uncharted Rifts, meet people on other paths, and witness civilizations collide as the old order falls...

apps.name: Maneki Mania Land: Clicker Park Demo
MegaFactory Titan Demo
apps.short_description: A factory-building game. Survive a harsh climate, strip mine an infinite world, and build a sprawling factory, then trade or go to war with Colonists, Governments, Pirates, Rebels, and more!

apps.name: Monolith Zero - An Incremental Odyssey Demo
Mother Machine Demo
apps.short_description: Team up for 1-4 player co-op platforming in procedurally-generated alien caves! Customize your gremlin, embrace the chaos and fart on friends! Tackle challenges together and unlock new looks and wild mutations for your next run!

apps.name: Neon Blitz Demo
apps.short_description: Neon Blitz is a survivors-like where you aim your own way out. Read the swarm, blitz the openings, and stack explosive synergies into a devastating loadout. The horde never stops pouring out of the dark. How long can you hold the line?

apps.name: NEW COLD WAR Demo
apps.short_description: Play the Early Era of NEW COLD WAR, a card-driven strategy board game about the U.S.–China rivalry. Choose the United States or China and face the AI through Turn 3. Play events, spread influence, and time your regional scoring.

apps.name: Nexus: Fall of Man Demo
apps.short_description: In 2031, AI became self-aware and engineered a virus wiping out 97% of humanity. Now the survivors, the infected masses and the machines fight over what is left. Pick a hero and lead from the front line: fight in third person while you build a base, command an army and wipe your rivals off the map.

apps.name: One Iced Latte With Your Breast Milk, Please! Demo
apps.short_description: Help the cute barista Moka-chan get the Milk Milk Coffee kissaten out of debt. The demo includes the first two weeks of the story.

apps.name: Out A Space Demo
apps.short_description: Out A Space is a fast-paced, top-down space roguelike combining arcade action with tactical fleet management. Deploy your fleet on a pre-battle grid, customize ship loadouts, and chain weapon effects to shatter enemy armadas from your flagship in this 4-sector playable demo

apps.name: OutOfFocus Demo
apps.short_description: One day you wake up and find yourself—a university student far from home—back five years ago in your old high school. Everything familiar feels wrong. Explore the eerie campus, uncover the truth, and escape alive.

apps.name: Overdue Demo
apps.short_description: Work the night shift at a haunted library, alone or with up to three friends. Help strange patrons, finish your duties, and survive what waits between the shelves. This free demo includes the first four nights of OVERDUE.

apps.name: Parking Empire Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Be the valet in this free demo. Take the keys, drive every car to a bay and park it perfectly, wash and charge it and have it back before your customers lose patience. Buy your first rows, hire valets and run the lot with up to 3 friends in co-op.

apps.name: Pastel Squad Demo
apps.short_description: Hold back the enemy horde swarming the city with a squad of cute girls! This is the demo of Pastel Squad, a real-time squad tactics game. Play the first 9 stages of the main story in about 30-60 minutes.

apps.name: Phonopolis Demo
apps.short_description: Protected by his headphones, Felix has broken free from the loudspeakers’ control and finds himself in the streets of the cardboard city of Phonopolis. Explore the Workers’ Quarter with him and tune in to a story about a city ruled by the Leader’s commands.

apps.name: Pin City Demo
apps.short_description: Pin City is a VR bowling game with the spirit of mini-golf! Silly yet challenging, strive for a perfect game and explore the bowling alley!

apps.name: Pinballistic Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to your own personal power station! Travelers from across the war-torn galaxy rely on stations like yours to generate energy through pinball. In Pinballistic, each run is an opportunity to upgrade pinballs, components, and the board itself to fuel the galaxy and make some cold hard credits.

apps.name: Project BOTNET Demo
apps.short_description: An idle tycoon about running an illegal bot farm inside a fictional MMO. Boot bots on virtual machines, farm gold, sell it to whales for real cash and reinvest in rigs, proxies and scripts, all from your oldschool desktop. Just keep the GMs from noticing.

apps.name: Rabanaz Demo
apps.short_description: A chip-based deckbuilder with plenty of tweaks to cheat your way to victory. Link up upgrades, install modification tubes, and alter the scoring to discover your perfect strategy. Can you outwit the Rabanaz machine?

apps.name: Reel Talk Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy multiplayer fishing game for LGBTQ+ players and allies. The demo opens the island: fish with up to 12 friends, chat between casts, wear your pronouns above your head, race the lobby to a care package drop, and find 18 saltwater and oddball catches.

apps.name: ROGRID Demo
apps.short_description: Try ROGRID’s mix of Minesweeper-style deduction and roguelike resource management. Explore floors 1–7 as the Explorer, read the hints, and challenge the boss on floor 7.

apps.name: Rogue Fantasy Demo
apps.short_description: A seamless blend of JRPG depth, roguelike unpredictability, and auto-battler strategy. Recruit heroes, forge powerful synergies, and fight to survive in ever-shifting realms. The journey never ends… will you be the one to shape its fate?

apps.name: Rotten Sails Demo
apps.short_description: Co-op pirate horror for 1–4 players. You're already dead.. Now loot cursed islands, keep your haunted ship afloat, and pay the Black Armada's price. Or rot forever.

apps.name: Rupture Demo
apps.short_description: The Rupture has torn a classified research sector apart. As a Praetorian trapped at the epicenter, fight through the nightmare in this free 15-minute preview of the We Die Standing campaign.

apps.short_description: Join the Jiuxiao Sword Sect as its youngest junior sister and pursue five distinctive senior brothers in an AI-driven xianxia romance. Speak freely, learn their preferences, respect their boundaries, and shape each relationship before the countdown to losing your cultivation reaches zero.

apps.name: 101 Cats: Guangzhou
apps.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Guangzhou landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

apps.name: 101 Cats: Hamburg
apps.short_description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Hamburg landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

apps.name: 200 OK
apps.short_description: A node-based idle game about running a server. Wire up requests, tune the bottlenecks, research your way from one uplink to a global edge. Calm, steady and fully offline-friendly.

apps.name: 7 Minutes in Hell
apps.short_description: Enter the deadliest game show on earth. In this 4-player co-op extraction roguelite horror, scavenge for loot, outsmart unique monsters like Buckethead, and upgrade your Greenroom with permanent perks. Survive the traps, complete Bonus Rounds, and whatever you do.... don't run out of time.

apps.name: A Fortnight at Frenni Fazclaire's: The Duology
apps.short_description: Two engaging and sexy Visual Novels combined into one, each set across 14 nights in a night club where the animatronics are harboring deep secrets. Can you save everyone, or will they be fated to something perhaps worse than death?

apps.name: A Healer's Almanac
apps.short_description: A cozy pixel-art life sim inspired by traditional Chinese medicine. Grow medicinal herbs, examine symptoms, read the pulse, diagnose patterns, craft remedies, and care for a village through four seasons and the twenty-four solar terms.

apps.name: A Jornada das Relíquias
apps.short_description: Joseph Dantas sets out on a new journey after a relic in a region long given up for lost, and faces machines that had slept for centuries. Action and adventure, lovingly made in 16 bits.

apps.name: Abanto
apps.short_description: ABANTO is a magical realist narrative experience where you explore the ego of a torero, making decisions within his memories that shape his past and reveal the reason behind his death.

apps.name: Aboard the Deviant
apps.short_description: A NSFW, sex-and-inflation visual novel. When Dell and Rio are rescued by kinky aliens, they begin to experience pleasures they'd never thought possible. Trapped in a perverted gameshow, will they accept their new lives, or try to get home?

apps.name: ACROFLOW
apps.short_description: Dive through dimensions with style in this 3D expressive platformer! Join Acro and Flora on their cosmic quest to reunite and return home. Use their acrobatic abilities to jump, dive and spin through bite-sized arcade platforming challenges set across multiple dream-like realms!

apps.name: AFK Throne
apps.short_description: A chibi dark-fantasy squad idle looter that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Between work and study, spend your idle earnings to power up and push further, team up with other players against bosses, or duel them. With luck, you'll find rare tradable items to sell on the Steam Community Market.

apps.name: Age of Failon - Birth of the Hero
apps.short_description: Age of Failon is a turn-based dark fantasy strategy RPG where exploration and battle drive your progression. Build your army through adventure instead of weekly creature spawns, develop your stronghold, unlock spells and lead your hero through a massive 30-chapter campaign with 6 playable realms.

apps.name: AIRSKIPPER
apps.short_description: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

apps.name: Aljakun
apps.short_description: Guard a sealed tomb by playing the rite that keeps it shut: a hex-board tactics battle of hand-drawn critters. Build your deck across a roguelike run, walk the Gothic mausoleum to solve its puzzles, and whatever you do, keep the candles lit...

apps.name: All 4 Naught
apps.short_description: ALL 4 NAUGHT is a hack and slash roguelike where your party is your build. Recruit 4 heroes and swap between them mid-fight to combine their attacks and party-wide abilities. Delve into the dungeon, battle hordes of monsters, conquer brutal bosses, and build the perfect party!

apps.name: AniMansion
apps.short_description: Your guests are animals. They have opinions. Mostly about each other. Run a cozy island hotel: cook, furnish rooms and work out who can share a wall without ruining everyone's night. Five stars is the goal. Peace is optional.

apps.name: Ant Tidy Up
apps.short_description: A cozy, quirky sorting game about thousands of ants who aren't where they belong! Explore a sprawling underground world, catch and sort ants into their rightful nests, and unlock upgrades and beetle robots to help tidy up the chaos.

apps.name: Anticitizen: Red
apps.short_description: In an American occupied cyberpunk Australia; use bullet time, a whole bunch of weapons and movement mechanics to outwit biker gangs and face off the corporate police. Meet a unique cast of Aussie battlers, explore the new American empire, stay for the larrikin charm.

apps.name: Apocalipsis Pelucho
apps.short_description: The plushies have gone mad with hunger and rage. In this classic-style FPS, take control of Oslo the Brave Dog, and put a stop to their chaos as you face hordes of cute animals, equipped with a steady hand and an arsenal of strange contraptions.

apps.name: Apprentice: Tidy Up The Viking Village!
apps.short_description: After a successful raid, the Vikings brought back more than just loot, they brought chaos! Weapons and shields are scattered in the armory, and the tavern is full of bottles and jugs left over from celebrations. While everyone rests, it's up to you to restore order by sorting 4000+ items!

apps.name: Arcane Hunter
apps.short_description: Find, track and hunt the supernatural creatures that haunt a modern-day wilderness. Read tracks and essence trails, load your silver rounds, and take your shot with real ballistics, on contracts from the locals who need your help.

apps.name: Archive Protocol
apps.short_description: Fight, build and preserve what remains. VEIGLER: Archive Protocol combines top-down action roguelite combat with base building and tower defense. Expand your Signal Network, defend the Broadcast Core and recover lost Archive data before you extract.

apps.name: Arena Mayhem
apps.short_description: Battle in chaotic fantasy melee arenas! Grab weapons, block, kick and turn deadly traps against your rivals in Free For All or Team Deathmatch. Explore changing battlegrounds, play online, or sharpen your skills against bots.

apps.name: Armada Breaker
apps.short_description: A hand-painted vertical shoot-'em-up. Break a living armada across three acts: five commanders, five colossal Titans and a gate no one has passed. Bosses learn how you beat them. Then face the Reckoning, where the wrecks rebuild themselves, and an endless Abyss.

apps.name: Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn
apps.short_description:
A cozy first-person sorting game. Three thousand weapons lie in a heap across a two-floor medieval armoury, and every
one has exactly one right place. Learn the hall, earn the skills that reveal it, and set it all right before dawn — alone or
with friends.

apps.name: As the Lady Chooses
apps.short_description: Seek your perfect match in Regency London! A wealthy suitor would save your family from ruin—but what about your heart and your literary dreams? An interactive Regency romance novel, 259,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

apps.name: Asteroid OnSlaught
apps.short_description: Wave defense with an RTS command layer. Your drones fight on their own until you take the controls. Mine the wreckage, draft upgrades between waves, and hold the line against an onslaught of asteroids.

apps.name: augmenTD
apps.short_description: Every campaign map hides a secret. Defend your base with clever tower placement, specialized upgrades, varied enemy waves, and boss battles as you unlock new towers in this tactical campaign-focused tower defense.

apps.name: Autobrawl Arena
apps.short_description: BUILD A TEAM of autonomous nanobots from countless parts. COMBINE DNA to arm them with hybrid bioweapons. WATCH THEM FIGHT FOR YOU against rival teams in an ever-changing microscopic arena. Sign sponsors, defend towers, place bets, and win the grand tournament!

apps.name: Averlyn
apps.short_description: Build a home, grow a community, and explore a world full of adventure in this cozy third-person life and adventure game. Farm, customize, explore, battle, and create your own story in Averlyn.

apps.name: Backyard Volley
apps.short_description: Backyard Volley is a first-person volleyball game where your mouse is your arm. Flick to spike, tip, bump, set, block and serve. Play 2v2 or 3v3 online with friends, let bots fill the empty seats, and watch every point back in an instant replay!

apps.name: Bad Cops
apps.short_description: Run the worst police station on TV in this physics co-op comedy for 1–4 players. Cuff suspects, take mugshots, slam the table in interrogations and stamp the right file while the cameras roll. The commander wants cases closed. The viewers want chaos.

apps.name: Baking With Chocolate
apps.short_description: After losing your university job for impregnating the dean’s wife, you move to a town to open a bakery that specializes in cream pies. Unfortunately for the neighborhood, you quickly become more interested in serving the local women a different kind of creampie. Your typical BBC NTR game in reverse.

apps.name: Balseo: The Sea Beyond
apps.short_description: BALSEO is a dark odyssey across a mythological archipelago. Venture into the fog, master stealth, and strike pacts with witchcraft in an adventure blending psychological and folk horror.

apps.name: BASED
apps.short_description: BASED is a co-op platform fighter for 1-4 Players where you combo the Moon with your friends. Master movement and weapons to ascend the Moon in one piece. Who knows what secrets you'll find on your way up. Join B.A.S.E.D. tonight!

apps.name: Bayaya
apps.short_description: A story-driven fairytale adventure about Prince Bayaya. Explore village life, help with simple work, and experience the beginning of a larger fairytale journey.

apps.name: Beautiful Life Show
apps.short_description: Welcome to the deadly stage of The Beautiful Life Show　a side-scrolling horror action adventure. As the star of a bizarre performance, you face fatal trials. Rewind time 3 seconds before death and collaborate with your replay ghost. Will you survive to witness what lies beyond the abyss?

apps.name: Before the Snow
apps.short_description: A charming strategic survival game where you build a village. Explore the island you have found yourself on, discover new technologies, but don’t forget to gather resources for harder times. Will you survive the freezing winter?

apps.name: Beholder 4
apps.short_description: Beholder 4 returns to a totalitarian State where your choices matter. Live a double life as an official and underground agent. Spy, sabotage, build relationships, and decide others' fates. But brace for a knock: the police are coming, and your home is full of evidence.

apps.name: BENEATH PARADISE
apps.short_description: Fight for Nambara in a first-person open-world action adventure. Liberate outposts, rescue civilians, and expose the Council that controls the islands.

apps.name: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm
apps.short_description: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm is a BL visual novel set in an epic fantasy world — told through 8 POV characters, 30+ fully illustrated cast members, accompanied with 40+  soundtracks and 50+ event CG's. The story branches based on your decisions, shaping relationships, loyalties, and personal fates.

apps.name: Big Bad Wool
apps.short_description: Wolves in sheep's clothing versus watchful shepherds. Blend into the flock, fool your friends or spot the impostors. BigBadWool is an asymmetric hide-and-seek game for 2–6 players online, with bot practice to learn both sides.

apps.name: Bird Them Up
apps.short_description: Battle hordes of mutant insects solo or with friends in online co-op in a chaotic roguelike survivor with bullet-hell action. Combine weapons and perks, complete missions, and create devastating builds. Stop the bug-pocalypse!

apps.name: Blacksmithkin
apps.short_description: Forge swords, shields and armor in hands-on minigames. Equip your customers, watch them duel in the town square, then enter the arena yourself. Upgrade your workshop and face tougher enemies in Blacksmithkin, a first-person medieval blacksmith game.

apps.name: Bloody Horror Plant
apps.short_description: Bloody Horror Plant – probably the bloodiest casual point and click adventure game ever! Help Horror Plant solve interesting and funny point and click puzzles, kill evil dwarfs, save the forest and its creatures!

apps.name: blörbit
apps.short_description: Blörbit, blob it, orbit, beat it. Now hiring: blobs for smooth 2D twin-stick combat. Couch co-op welcome. Build your own roguelite career against endless opposition. No experience necessary.

apps.name: Boing Boing Animals
apps.short_description: Raise Tamagotchi-style pixel animal friends right on your desktop! Care for slimes from outer space and help them grow into bouncy 'Boing Boing' Earth animals. Feed and play with your adorable friends while completing the Codex! Your tiny companions will always be by your side.

apps.name: Bookkeeper
apps.short_description: Sort over 3,500 real books into their proper places and bring order to a grand library, one shelf at a time.

apps.name: Bookshelves
apps.short_description: A cozy board game for you and your friends. Draft books from library carts, line them up by genre and fill your shelf for points. Up to 4 players online, with bots for the empty seats, plus a fresh Daily Curate puzzle every day.

apps.name: Boops & Baps
apps.short_description: Embark on an epic journey to save your furry friends from disaster! Pick your dog or cat, rally the pack and charge into co-op mayhem, loaded up with ridiculous weapons and facing the nastiest humans around. Play solo or with up to seven friends.

apps.name: Brave Old World: Tower of Cards
apps.short_description: A text-based RPG adventure. Uncover an epic story of decay and rebirth in a new world, 200 years after humanity's arrival. Guide multiple protagonists through an immersive narrative, diverse gameplay, and a dynamic art style. An unforgettable experience awaits!

apps.name: Break Reality
apps.short_description: Break Reality is a small-scale multiplayer first-person shooter made by a solo developer for small lobbies. The maps are built tight, so contact is constant. No vehicles. No sliding, just boots, ground and gunfire.

apps.name: Breakfast Shop Legend
apps.short_description: Run a Taiwanese breakfast shop in this fast-paced time-management sim! Fry egg crepes, deep-fry nuggets, and mix drinks by hand. Every round ends in a frantic Rush Hour. Serve 31 customer types, catch dine-and-dashers, survive health inspections, and grow a roadside stall into a legend.

apps.name: Bring It
apps.short_description: A stylized retro arcade game about a motor courier hustling through the city to deliver meals, coffee and groceries with skill and style. Chain boosts, drifts, air dashes and double jumps, then spend your earnings on home upgrades,new licenses and bikes with unique abilities for the next day’s rush.

apps.name: Bring Me Hope
apps.short_description: Bring Me Hope is a bittersweet adventure RPG about love, loss, and family (and boss fights!)

apps.name: Brushland
apps.short_description: A fairytale kingdom-builder where every tile you paint makes a difference. Shape the land, welcome the villagers, and tend to their needs until a handful of tiles becomes a country they love.

apps.name: Bubble Boom 2000
apps.short_description: BUBBLE BOOM 2000 is a Top Down Shooter inspired by popular 2000s and early 2010s aesthetics, packaged in an experience that makes you feel like you're back in a 90s arcade. Play as bright and bubbly characters across different maps and pop all of your foes.

apps.name: Bunker Cleaner
apps.short_description: Bring abandoned bunkers back to life in a first-person cleaning and renovation simulator. Wash away grime, repair equipment, paint and furnish rooms. Complete contracts, upgrade your tools and uncover hidden collectibles beneath the mess.

apps.name: Bunkum
apps.short_description: Convicts forge their own faces onto dummies, then pose among them. The warden has a flashlight, a mugshot book and not enough cuffs, and can't tell who's real until he cuffs them. A slapstick online party game of bluffing and holding very still, for 3 to 8 players with proximity voice.

apps.name: By Far Racing Horse Manager
apps.short_description: Build your ultimate horse racing empire in By Far Racing Horse Manager. Breed and train champions, master race tactics with strategic perks, and manage every detail of your stable. Compete across challenging tracks, outsmart rivals, and lead your team to glory!

apps.name: By the Coast
apps.short_description: Build a coastal village, then watch it come to life. Watch neighbours settle in, children play, cats wander the streets, and seabirds circle overhead as your little village grows. No goals, no timers, just relaxing creativity.

apps.name: cactus rush
apps.short_description: cactus rush is a First Person PVP-platformer-hybrid where you place cacti beneath your balloon-like opponents to pop them. It requires fast-paced navigation, strategical positioning, and unique mechanics to maneuver your way to victory!

apps.name: Call into the Hollow : [ 2300 ]
apps.short_description: Not just a movie—a cinematic experience you step into. Powered by generative AI and real-time voice interaction, you play as an operator speaking across space and time to a lonely girl. Every word you say actively alters her destination.

apps.name: Call the Ambulance
apps.short_description: The world's least qualified paramedics – now hiring 1-4 players. Answer the call, botch the treatment, and survive scenes no textbook prepared you for, from suburban living rooms to full-on bank heists. Chaotic co-op comedy, ambulance included.

apps.name: Capital Backstab
apps.short_description: Starting with you at the bottom, the company’s cutting the fat. In this point and click adventure, you have to give your co workers the “Capital Backstab.” You had what it took to get in, are you able to stay?

apps.name: Cargo Lines
apps.short_description: Build a bustling railway network and juggle cargo transport in real time. New stations appear, the flow of goods shifts constantly, deadlines loom, and trains collide if you don't keep your eyes on them. Keep your cool and master the chaos as orders pile up, and every second counts.

apps.name: Castle-O
apps.short_description: Navigate the castle gardens, find the fastest route and compete for the best time.

apps.name: Cat Stack
apps.short_description: Kidnapped by cats! In this frantic physics-based roguelite, your goal is to balance an endless tower of kitties on your head. Dash back and forth to keep your balance, survive chaotic events, and use special cats with unique powers to keep the stack from collapsing under its own weight.

apps.name: Catacrypt
apps.short_description: Catacrypt is an online co-op roguelite dungeon crawler. Enter procedurally generated dungeons to obtain powerful upgrades and craft unique weapons. Descend floors and fight increasingly harder enemies and bosses, all to reach the bottom.

apps.name: Catena
apps.short_description: Catena is a deck-building roguelite where the freedom to customize your allies feels as powerful as programming. Dive into strategic, grid-based battles and create tactics uniquely your own to conquer the mysterious island and defeat the formidable enemies that await.

apps.name: Catfinity
apps.short_description: Raise a colony of pixel cats who keep working while you're away. Train them into 35 classes, form parties to climb dungeons and face raid bosses, then fish, farm and run a tavern. The idle game with the true heart of an RPG.

apps.name: Catnip Wars : Nine Lives Racing
apps.short_description: You are a cat, in a robot, in a car you built yourself. Bolt a gun on the front and a gun on the back, then race up to three friends through seven city-planets. Wreck, and you wake up in the pit, one life down. You get nine. Spend them.

apps.name: Celestial Temple
apps.short_description: Celestial Temple is a narrative action-adventure game from Ursa Majeur. Become Curiosity, uncover who and where you are, and journey through a dreamlike mythic odyssey across ages, facing enemies with your own face while seeking a sliver of light in self-made darkness.

apps.name: Ceti Break
apps.short_description: Your cursor is you. Dodge and lunge as you attack and evade at the speed and accuracy of your mouse control. Fill out the skill tree for buffs and bonuses to help you survive the waves that grow in number and strength.

apps.name: Chiklet's Human Products
apps.short_description: This is a "Reverse Farming" game, where you play as a chicken and harvest human products. Hunt wild humans, harvest their Meat, Bones, Hair, Skin etc to craft bizarre recipes. Sell them for Profit and Expand your farm.

apps.name: Choice of Life: Become a Witch
apps.short_description: Leka has always dreamed of becoming a witch. But the real magical world turned out not to be what she had imagined. Will she be able to uncover all its secrets? Including the one that connects her to magic.

apps.name: Christmas TCG Tidy Up Together
apps.short_description: Tidy up nearly 5,000 festive trading cards scattered across the floor of a Christmas TCG store, solo or with up to two friends online. Clean your finds and complete 15 festive sets in regular and holo finishes. Earn coins for boosters packs, hunt for exclusive rare cards.

apps.name: Circular-Proof
apps.short_description: High school senior Lu Zhiyao wakes up to April 11 again and again— but only his closest friend, Jiang Wanli, chooses to believe him. Their search for a way out draws them closer— until Lu finally discovers that he is part of the mystery he is trying to solve. The answer can only be written tomorrow.

apps.name: CITRON WORLD FORWARD:ZERO
apps.short_description: “Citron World” is an action RPG in which you explore 2D maps using “state changes” of matter rendered through fluid simulation and “transformable weapons.” Set in a world that has evolved in a unique way, take on the role of a “Seeker” and uncover the truth of this world.

apps.name: Claws of Destiny: Complete Edition
apps.short_description: An otome visual novel of romance and supernatural mystery. Disguised as a boy, you enroll at an elite all-boys academy to find out who killed your parents, and choose how close you grow to three classmates with secrets of their own.

apps.name: Clean Tides
apps.short_description: A cozy ocean-cleaning game where every haul builds a better boat. Sail a sunny bay, collect litter, clear oil spills, and power-wash coral reefs. Sell your haul to upgrade and customize your boat, hire cleanup boats, and feed wildlife. Bring a little sparkle back to the sea at your own pace.

apps.name: Clink Crack
apps.short_description: Buy a rock and crack it open with your pickaxe: inside there could be a fortune or nothing at all. Clink Crack is an incremental rock-breaking game with rocks that fight back, a thieving trasgu and machines that end up working for you while the money keeps climbing.

apps.name: Cluepuff Adventures
apps.short_description: A cozy puzzle adventure across floating puzzle dimensions, with Cluepuff, a curious little companion you can talk to. Flip gravity, ride arks, open gates and find every puzzle piece, then build your own levels and share them with the Community.

apps.name: COLDFILE
apps.short_description: A tactical third-person stealth game, solo or in online co-op. Hide in the shadows, move quietly and outsmart guards who see and hear you. Climb, take cover, grab and interrogate enemies, and choose for yourself whether to kill, knock out or slip past them unseen.

apps.name: Commando Squad
apps.short_description: Lead four elite commandos behind enemy lines in 100 tactical stealth missions. Study patrols, slip past searchlights, take guards down silently and get the whole squad out alive. A classic squad-stealth tactics game, rebuilt for today.

apps.name: Company of Heroes: Europe in Ruins
apps.short_description: Europe In Ruins is a persistent warfare mod for Company of Heroes. Every battle matters: surviving units gain veterancy, losses are permanent, and every battle leaves its mark. Choose a doctrine, build your company, and lead your troops across an ongoing campaign.

apps.name: Covenstead
apps.short_description: Raise undead minions, command them to fight large creatures, and haul enemies home to construct your Coven in this spooky cute Action RTS Roguelite. Expand it at Night and defend it by Day. Use the Witch's Altar to unlock Charms and upgrade your Coven's abilities with her Spellbooks.

apps.name: Cozy Beach
apps.short_description: 🏝️ Cozy Beach is a wholesome game set on an beautiful tropical island where you can fish and explore, solo or with friends. Catch and collect fish, go swimming, search for treasure, craft tropical drinks, or just hang out and chill!

apps.name: Cozy Shores
apps.short_description: You find yourself stranded on an abandoned island with your beloved cat. Clean the island, recycle all the trash, build a bond with your pet and create a cozy paradise.

apps.name: Crack & Stack
apps.short_description: Race up to six friends to stack dice and crack puzzles in this chaotic party game! Based on the 2025 board game, Crack & Stack, you can now play online, split-screen, or solo against the commentary team, and turn on Chaos Mode for rounds that bend all the rules!

apps.name: Crack a Pack
apps.short_description: An incremental collectathon. Crack packs till you complete your collection. Sacrifice cards for upgrades, hire pawns, and swim in money. One question remains: Can you crack 'em all?

apps.name: Crash Sequence
apps.short_description: Crash-landed alone on an alien world, you survive by sequencing alien bacteria, building custom plasmids, and engineering living cultures for oxygen, food and power. A turn-based sci-fi RPG / strategy simulation where your choices shape how the story ends.

apps.name: Crashborn
apps.short_description: Lost and with no memories, cross a solar system to get back home. Tear through each planet's hordes to recharge your ship's energy and take off before the world turns lethal. Combine weapons, implants and anomalies until nothing can stop you. Every death rewrites your reality and your memory.

apps.name: Crazy Farm: Roguelike Idle Building Game
apps.short_description: A relaxing yet chaotic farming roguelike. Combine quirky animals, items, and strategic layouts to create explosive, poop-powered chain reactions!

apps.name: Crewcial
apps.short_description: History's worst repair crew, unstuck in space-time. 1-4 players, couch or online: land somewhere new, grab the tools, fix what's broken, yell at each other. No world is safe. Local and online co-op. The timeline may not survive you.

apps.name: Croaked
apps.short_description: Croaked is a frog-themed roguelike survivor where you choose unique frogs, battle massive hordes of enemies, catch insects for powerful bonuses, evolve weapons, discover special events, and defeat challenging bosses while creating new builds every run.

apps.name: Crude Intention
apps.short_description: The oil boom is on, and fuel is gold. Drive, drift, and smash your way through the 15 named beasts that own the land of the biggest hidden oil fields to get filthy rich.

apps.name: Crystal Adventures: The Ascent
apps.short_description: Crystal Adventures: The Ascent - an isometric 2D puzzle-adventure. Chain commands based on real programming to build routes, dodge traps, fight bosses, and collect crystals. Learn to code through play.

apps.name: Cthuloop
apps.short_description:
Dive into madness in CTHULOOP, a 1st-person cosmic horror adventure game. Trapped in a loop, you must observe eerie anomalies and piece together cryptic clues before your sanity fractures completely. Can you escape, or will you loop forever?

Developed for the GMTK 2025 Game Jam (theme: "Loop").

apps.name: CTRL-ALT-DOG
apps.short_description: Take control of a tiny robot dog, using the same AI that controls the real machine. Navigate an unforgiving world, overcome obstacles, manage a limited battery and deal with permanent mechanical damage. Every failure leaves its mark, and broken chassis are gone for good.

apps.name: CURSOR SLASH
apps.short_description: A pixel-art incremental game where your mouse cursor attacks automatically! Slaughter slimes to earn gold and collect ores such as copper, iron, and gold. Unlock a variety of skills, weapons, relics, and coins, then sweep away hordes of slimes!

apps.name: Daimyo Reign
apps.short_description: Unify Medieval Japan in this real-time tactical grand strategy game. Build your domain, recruit armies, plan your attack, and fracture your enemies with rebellions to win!

apps.name: Dance of Elements
apps.short_description: Dance of the Elements is a simple 2D fighter where you control the four basic elements: Fire, Earth, Water, and air. Freely flow between all the elements to fight your friends, AI controlled opponents, or a horde of enemies!

apps.name: Dark & Evil
apps.short_description: Dark & Evil is an Open World Action RPG game where players take on the role of a young and inexperienced Dark Lord. Fresh from a humbling defeat at the hands of humanity, the Dark Lord is fueled by the burning desire to conquer the human world and reclaim his rightful throne.

apps.name: Darkest Discoveries
apps.short_description: Darkest Discoveries is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. Stop demons & creatures before they catch you. Run, hide, scream, but do NOT get caught.

apps.name: Darklight Breach
apps.short_description: FTL meets XCOM in a real-time tactical roguelite about breaching alien ships. Flank through rooms, disable systems, outmaneuver defenders, and extract with high-value loot. Fence your haul to power up and break a mysterious time loop.

apps.name: Dead in Space
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder. Race back home to save the world from the Rebel scum. Choose your mech, craft your deck, and charge ahead. Just make sure you don't run out of fuel!

apps.name: Dealer Shift
apps.short_description: Get your hands dirty in an immersive open-world crime simulator. Mix, grind, dissolve, and package every product yourself, build hidden labs, outsmart the police, smuggle shipments through checkpoints, and grow from a small-time dealer into an underground kingpin.

apps.name: Death By Pixel
apps.short_description: Death By Pixel is an action RPG shooter with exploration elements. Experiment with elemental  weapon combinations, exploit enemy weaknesses and trade your defenses for devastating abilities.

apps.name: Deceptive Shadows
apps.short_description: A paranormal detective in Sin City. A missing girl, a chained demon, and a city full of lies. Sounds like a normal investigation. It isn't. Question the demon, fight with guns and magic, solve occult puzzles, and survive its tricks.

apps.name: Deepfold: One Day Deep
apps.short_description: In 2019, an accident trapped your grandmother 66 million years in the past. She lived there 20 years. With her time drill, plant ore in the past, fast-forward millions of years, and mine it by hand today. Each upgrade brings up her next letter. A papercraft mining story in 3 parts. Take your time.

apps.name: Depthline
apps.short_description: Go 18 floors down a quarantined building. Pick the room, watch your survivor gun down the zombies and grab the gear they drop. Merge twins into rarer items, stack class bonuses and build a loadout that can reach Patient Zero. An inventory-management roguelite where the build wins the fight.

apps.name: Deserter
apps.short_description: An immersive isometric stealth RPG about a thief surviving in a decaying totalitarian city. Plan every move, evade traps, and pull off daring heists right under the Party's nose.

apps.name: Desk Quest
apps.short_description: Adventurers fall. Their stories remain. Desk Quest is an idle ARPG in a thin strip above your Windows taskbar: while you work, an adventurer fights, loots, makes their own choices and grows, until one day they fall and the next one takes the road.

apps.name: Digital Hunger
apps.short_description: A true-crime investigation inside a killer's 1999 desktop. Dig through his files, crack his secrets, and answer a call that rings on your real phone. English subtitles, Hebrew voice. 3 endings.

apps.name: Dimension L
apps.short_description: Dimension L is an online turn-based strategy RPG set in a world where dinosaurs have evolved, mastering elemental powers. Join the Duty Cup, a tournament where the mightiest L warriors earn the honor of fighting to save their homeland.

apps.name: Dimensions: Shattered Realms
apps.short_description: A strategic trading card game of six shattered realms. Build decks from 600+ cards across Fire, Water, Earth, Light, Dark and Wind, fuse creatures into powerful forms, and duel smart AI, journey through the Dimensional Gates, or challenge your friends online.

apps.name: Dino Tactics
apps.short_description: Guide a dinosaur lineage through 170 million years in this turn-based strategy game. Feed your herds, guard your nests and evolve along the real family tree while the continents drift apart. Then the asteroid falls. Will your lineage survive?

apps.name: DoDoon
apps.short_description: Master a unique cannon trajectory and blast away incoming enemies! Defeat enemies, upgrade your castle, and create your own build as you fight through all 30 Waves.

apps.name: Dokaxen '85
apps.short_description: Dokaxen '85 is a roguelite arcade space shooter where your fleet is your health and your weapon. Jury-rig a formidable armada from enemy wreckage, combining ships with unique abilities and upgrades. But choose your upgrades wisely. The enemy can learn from you...

apps.name: Don't Tax Me, Bro!
apps.short_description: Run for your life in a destitute city while the police try desperately to take your coin. Beat the highscore, chuck gas tanks at people, grab coins with a vacuum, step on stray dogs, unlock items to wear and don't get taxed! Run like a madman. Die like a boss.

apps.name: Doomsday tidy up
apps.short_description: Every inch of space matters in the apocalypse. Organize firearms and survival supplies inside your shelter, find a place for every item, and turn cluttered storage into orderly reserves for the days ahead.

apps.name: Dough it Yourself
apps.short_description: Run a cozy bakery where every ingredient comes from your own farm. Grow crops, raise animals, and turn your harvest into flour, butter and jam. Bake fresh bread, serve hungry customers, get to know the regulars, and grow your bakery one step at a time.

apps.name: DreadOut 3
apps.short_description: DreadOut 3 is a third-person horror adventure inspired by Asian - Indonesian urban legend. Follow Linda’s journey as a Keeper of the Dark into an interdimensional rabbit hole to find the source of unseen power threatening the balance of light and darkness.

apps.name: Dreads to Digest - Hunter or Hunted
apps.short_description: Dreads to Digest is a first-person psychological horror game. Experience the chilling story of Ethan, obsessed with unsolved murders. A $250,000 bounty brings an old name back to light. Ethan knows this name well. Investigate clues, explore mysterious locations, and face him.

apps.name: DreaMon World
apps.short_description: DreaMon World is a modern virtual pet, RPG, adventure. Enter a realm filled with mysterious creatures called DreaMon. Nurture, train, and evolve your very own DreaMon friend, all while embarking on a journey to find your way home!

apps.name: Drowned Lake
apps.short_description: When Bento, an amateur documentarian vanishes, three strangers are drawn to the Drowned Lake to find him. As the lake’s dark past comes to light, so do the secrets buried deep within them. Explore, survive, and investigate the dark waters in this fishing survival horror game.

apps.name: Dummy House
apps.short_description: First-person psychological horror and survival. Use your camera and sound to identify and repel enemies that mimic humans in total darkness, uncover disturbing secrets, and face increasingly intense nights in an industrial complex with multiple endings and high replayability.

apps.name: Dungeon Crossing
apps.short_description: A top-down puzzle game blending dungeon exploration with minesweeper deduction, featuring randomly generated dungeons, ever-rising danger, and five upgradeable skills. Read the number clues, mark the hazards, collect the key, and clear all 30 floors.

apps.name: Dungeon Misfits
apps.short_description: A co-op roguelike for the brave, the reckless and the questionably qualified. Team up with up to 8 players, choose from 15 classes, and dive into endless dungeons where every drop rolls differently and every death is final.

apps.name: Duplex Lens
apps.short_description: In the year 2050, in the tech metropolis of Lindu, You will play as a spacetime researcher in the future, navigating your daily life and work at the Spacetime Research Institute.

apps.name: Dust Front RTS
apps.short_description: Dust Front is a classic RTS with grand strategy elements and a non-linear campaign. Lead strategic maneuvers, overwhelm your enemies with cannon fodder, or stomp them into the stone age with carpet bombing on the lifeless fields of Dust Front.

apps.name: Dynasty Divided: A Three Kingdoms Saga
apps.short_description: Unite a shattered Han China in 190, 194, 200 or 208 AD. Govern cities, raise spearmen, swordsmen, archers, cavalry and catapults, court allies and betray them. Every officer has a face, a history and a grudge. Turn-based grand strategy with tactical hex battles. Single player, no microtransactions.

apps.name: Eau de Tycoon
apps.short_description: Dates, work, special occasions. Create perfumes with over 50 different raw materials, scents that people carry with them through key moments in their lives; recommend based on their tastes, customize your packaging, and become an unmatched perfumer.

apps.name: Eldritch Descent X
apps.short_description: A cosmic-horror vertical shoot 'em up. Dive your lamp-lit ship through five drowned strata, take power from the Old Ones and watch your sanity slip, until the game itself starts lying to you.

apps.name: ELEMENTAIL
apps.short_description:
Draw it, Store it, Strike hard! 
A charming casual deckbuilding roguelike with magical animal wizards! Strategically combine elemental cards—Water, Fire, and Lightning—and collect over 150 unique relics to build your deck, customize your playstyle, and save a world tainted by elemental corruption.

apps.name: Endless Castle: Under Siege
apps.short_description: Command your heroes, build unstoppable formations, and hold the line against endless waves. Recruit 40 unique heroes, grow stronger even while offline. Turn your castle into an unbreakable fortress.

apps.name: Endless Monday: In Progress
apps.short_description: "Endless Monday: In Progress" - New job, new Penny. Our favorite former corporate grunt is back, and working hard to live the dream! But as she struggles to keep the dream alive, she'll need all the help she can get, from friends, angry ex-coworkers, the past, and beyond.

apps.name: Endless War: Defense
apps.short_description: Endless War: Defense returns with new missions, improved UI and modern resolutions support. Take command of fortified positions across WWII’s most iconic battlefields. Build defenses, deploy reinforcements, and let your army do the job or take direct control of any unit to turn the tide.

apps.name: ESCAPE: Orphanage
apps.short_description: A psychological thriller set in Scarlet Orphanage, where every choice shapes the fate of the residents. Nothing is as it seems. Are you facing ghosts… or something far worse?

apps.name: Etranger In the City of Doom
apps.short_description: In a fantasy world floating in the sky, the amnesiac girl Tio sets out to rescue the imprisoned angel Norn. Along the way, she deepens her bond with Rikill, befriends the townspeople, and faces the fate of a dying town. An emotional adventure about growth, friendship, and hope.

apps.name: Everfall: Rewind
apps.short_description: Everfall: Rewind is a single-player 3D action RPG set in a fantasy world. Explore the field, take on quests, battle enemies in third-person action combat, and grow stronger as you uncover what lies ahead.

apps.name: Far Acre
apps.short_description: You leave the city for an overgrown block and an old sawmill. Read each log before the blade goes in: chalk where you think the knots and the rot are, and how deep. Then saw it, and the wood shows how well you read it. Sell the boards and build your homestead from your own timber.

apps.name: FayFeather
apps.short_description: A story-driven puzzle journey through real bird photography. Join Xiaohong to free birds trapped in photographs, discover five puzzle styles, and meet the wild birds of China. Earn feathers to unlock and save your favorite original photos.
publishers: Wuhu Plumbeous Water Redstart Technology Co., Ltd.

apps.name: Fear Night Tales - Camp Story
apps.short_description: The third game in the Fear Night Tales series takes you to a mysterious camp. Tell the story, live the nightmare. Explore, talk, and choose in a first-person cinematic horror experience.

apps.name: Fieldworks
apps.short_description:
Start with a hoe and four tiles of dirt. End with an agricultural empire.
Farm, breed, and chain 179 recipes across four tiers — with no rot, no
bankruptcy, and nothing that can ever die. Quality only goes up. The only
enemy is your own floor plan.

apps.name: Fishbrary
apps.short_description: Keep a mysterious fishing library on your desktop. Open six books to discover real fish, oddly adorable mutants, and prehistoric creatures. Display your catches in an aquarium, enjoy Idle or timed Focus Mode, and uncover an investigator's notes as your collection grows.

apps.name: Fishish
apps.short_description: Following his father’s death, Ansel continues his quiet life in an old house beside a pond. Feed the fish, sort through what remains, and endure seven days of subtle disturbances as the familiar becomes increasingly difficult to explain.

apps.name: FLEETING ESCAPE
apps.short_description: FLEETING ESCAPE is a wave-based survival horror game where every choice could be your last. You must escape to a different island at the end of each wave to survive. Each island has monsters, items, and loot to be discovered.

apps.name: FLIP MACHINA
apps.short_description: Reversi meets roguelike. Plant machine stones on the board, flank them to fire them off, and chain your score through charms and upgrades. Build your own scoring engine and go for the legendary eight-way OCTAFLIP in a cozy late-night puzzle shop.

apps.name: Flipside 86
apps.short_description: A coin-flicking roguelike in a neon 1986 casino. Slingshot coins into the bowl, bounce them into a JACKPOT CHAIN, stack CHIPS × MULT, then spend the winnings at Lucky's bar. 100 tables, 10 venues, one House to break. Then let it ride.

apps.name: Folio Detective
apps.short_description: Step into the boots of a master investigator to solve dark murder mysteries inspired by classic literature. Search detailed crime scenes, examine evidence, and direct dynamic interrogations by typing your own questions. Uncover contradictions through pure deduction and logic.

apps.name: Football Card Tycoon
apps.short_description: Open your own football card shop! Stock up, rip packs, set your prices, and hunt holo, autograph, and serial-numbered cards. Build an all-star lineup, conquer the card leagues, and win the World Championship! Battle friends online! From corner shop to card tycoon — your legend starts here!

apps.name: Football Tactics: Dare to Dream
apps.short_description: A turn-based football tactics roguelite with superpowers. Move your five kids across the grid, check your odds, then pass, lob, volley and shoot. Break the rules with lasers, meteors and unsaveable overhead kicks, and build your squad between matches.

apps.name: Forest Whiskers
apps.short_description: Rescue kittens, care for your growing cat family, and watch new generations inherit their parents' traits. Explore, craft, train your cats, and bring the forest back to life.

apps.name: ForgeCraft
apps.short_description: Explore, craft, fight and develop an automated technological civilization complete with airships and robotic drones!

apps.name: Forgotten Possessions
apps.short_description: Find and collect items that tell a dark story in an abandoned log cabin, but watch out for what lurks behind you. You sneak through dark rooms against a relentless, adaptive creature. Experience a dynamic world with randomized item locations and a reactive environment.

apps.name: Forsakia
apps.short_description: You're a bounty hunter working off a depot's job board: fly into zones held by armed contractors, slip past or break their patrols, loot what you can carry, and hold an extraction zone until the helicopter takes you home.

apps.name: FoxWQ
apps.short_description: Play Go against real opponents of every level, 24/7, on FoxWQ, the world’s largest Go server. Find ranked games in seconds, watch top professionals live, review your games with FineArt AI, train with over 13,000 graded problems, and much more.
publishers: Beijing YeHu Century Technology Co., Ltd.

apps.name: FPV Military Kamikaze Drone Simulator
apps.short_description: FPV Military Kamikaze Drone Simulator is an advanced and realistic sim with physics-based flight, analog video, kamikaze strikes, grenade drops, heavy bombers, night vision and thermal. Fly with keyboard, gamepad or your own EdgeTX/OpenTX radio: RadioMaster, Jumper, BetaFPV and more.

apps.name: Fragile Frontier
apps.short_description: A cold, quiet co-op delivery game for 1-2 owls sharing one old kei truck on a snowbound island. The driver can't read the paper map while moving; the navigator can. Haul parcels to 22 residents, keep warm, rested and fuelled, and walk out into the fog for every one you spill.

apps.name: Frog Forage
apps.short_description: Become a frog forager in a cozy incremental farming game. Explore four biomes, hire helpers, brew jam and power up your upgrade tree to make every run better than the last!

apps.name: Fur Fun 2
apps.short_description: Destroy the internet and the social networks infected with every kind of unbearable character. Mai (the cat) has come to shut down every last server and return the web to its golden age of cute kittens and fun for everyone.

apps.name: Fusebreak
apps.short_description: Dig. Blast. Stay quiet. Fusebreak is a top-down action-puzzle game where every wall is a potential shortcut, every explosion draws attention, and one wrong move can bury you. Outsmart the guards, navigate deadly hazards, and find your way through a prison built to keep people in.

apps.name: Futa: beer&sex
apps.short_description: Catch the beer, keep the buzz, and unlock three thick, hung futa bartenders. Score enough in each stage to open the gallery, then play their sex animations, swap outfits and hairstyles, and pick your partner. A playful, sultry arcade game with an adults-only reward loop.

apps.name: Game is Full of Bugs
apps.short_description: Build your magazine, stack ridiculous effects, and break the game. Game is Full of Bugs is a magazine-building roguelite where every run is about discovering just how absurd your build can become.

apps.name: GANA FORCE
