apps.short_description: A co-op dungeon action game. A calamity has woken beneath a village, and the last summons brought you here. In parties of up to 10, descend into ever deadlier depths, slay the bosses below, and bring back stronger weapons and lost powers — if you survive.

apps.name: The Lonely Helmet
apps.short_description: In a galaxy far far away, there was a collection of helmets. Some were stronger than others, some were smaller and some were bigger, but all helmets had a purpose - to protect their space-human and allow them to breath outside of the Universe.

apps.name: The Ones Who Answered
apps.short_description: When a catastrophic global anomaly known as "The Knocking" drags you into a nightmare dimension, you must fight to survive. Play as YouTuber Pisty and team up with an ally, Perm, to escape a four-layer hellscape. Solve puzzles, evade terrifying threats, and defeat the creator of this twisted world..

apps.name: The Patchwork Ship
apps.short_description: A sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder with a unique card-generating system for flexible strategic runs without micromanagement. Your brain controls a space probe fleeing a failed mining operation. Can you survive the hostile skies and escape a dying star?

apps.name: The Peninsula's Downfall
apps.short_description: After a brutal civil war in the 2020s, the nation once called the "Republic of Korea" is finally gone. On the divided peninsula of 2030, lead a nation with a fate of its own: command your divisions, build your economy, and decide whether to return to Seoul's rule or break with the past forever.

apps.name: The Red Cathedral
apps.short_description: The Red Cathedral is a fun turn-based strategy game for 1 to 4 players. Manage your resources well to build the cathedral better than anyone else and thus win the Tsar's favor.

apps.name: The Red Inn
apps.short_description: First-person PS1-style stealth horror. No weapons, no combat. The last bus is gone, and you’re left at a seaside inn in a Hokkaido snowstorm, with polite hosts who hear everything, even your voice if you turn on the mic. Find the proof and get out, or no one will believe you.

apps.name: The Rift Between Us
apps.short_description: Jordan must traverse an apocalyptic world to find his love, Ember. Knowing not what fate has befallen her, Jordan will fight across any number of miles and confront any monstrosity the looming rift throws his way...

apps.name: The Rug Racket
apps.short_description: Inherit a rundown rug-cleaning shop and master a satisfying craft. Dust, wash, rinse and revive rugs one stain at a time. Build a reputation, keep the lights on, and squirm out from under the mob family that owns your debt. Every rug's a small win, and every tribute payment says you're not free yet.

apps.name: The Saga of Three Realms
apps.short_description: Every hunt could turn up rare treasure. Every road has its dangers, and any open patch of land could be your home. Saga is a classic sandbox MMORPG where you fight, craft, tame, trade and build your way to legend. The rest of the realm’s secrets, you’ll have to find.

apps.name: The Tower Stories Green 1
apps.short_description: In a magical universe adorned with colorful characters from various races, we invite you to a visual novel adventure that will lead you to different endings. Define your own path in this captivating fantasy world and set sail on an unforgettable journey.

apps.name: The Transfer
apps.short_description: A Lovecraftian point-and-click adventure. As a London Tube driver, your routine journey derails into something ancient, forgotten, and buried beneath the tracks. Explore hidden routes, follow the journey, and unravel the secrets that refuse to stay dormant.

apps.name: The Transforming Detective - Gay Bara RPG Game
apps.short_description:
This is an adult gay bara (Male/Male) detective RPG.
Use the protagonist's transformation abilities to solve mysterious cases and seduce men throughout the city. 
Manage your own public bathhouse and create the erotic bathhouse of your dreams.
Enjoy over 45 high-quality animated adult scenes!

apps.name: The Velan Reach - Book One
apps.short_description: An adult steampunk Visual Novel where you take on the role of a scientist joining a mission of discovery and wonder. Travel to strange new worlds and get to know your traveling companions (quite intimately so, in some cases).

apps.name: This is Not a Snake Game
apps.short_description: ▶When the classic Snake Game becomes self-aware, eating apples is no longer enough! Help this little snake exploit bugs to escape the game and roam your desktop. Collect adorable outfits and dress up its long, wiggly tail! (⦿ʌ⦿)

apps.name: ThrillWorx
apps.short_description: Build a theme park, then grab a front-row seat. Design coaster tracks, choose from 100 attractions, and explore your midway on foot. When a ride goes down, climb into the WrenchWorx pickup, bring the parts, and get it running again

apps.name: Tick or Kick!
apps.short_description: Grab them by the leg, check their ticket and throw the freeloaders off the bus. Or ride for free, blend into the crowd and blame someone else. A physics party game about tickets, chaos and flying passengers, for up to 16 friends.

apps.name: Tidy Up Creator: Make And Play Tidy Up Games
apps.short_description: A hilarious cozy first-person tidying game for movie lovers! Hand crafted movie posters parodying real movies. Absolutely No Generative AI. Plus, a level editor to create your own packs and the same familiar game loop you’re familiar with in the genre.

apps.name: Tinyfab
apps.short_description: Build your own factory in the cozy pixel-art world of Tinyfab. Move goods by belt and cannon, generate power and brew drinks from your crops. But the CO2 from your factory wakes the enemies in nearby graveyards. Build up your defenses, defeat the enemies and upgrade your factory with their loot.

apps.name: TION: Hero Awakening — Idle RPG
apps.short_description: Build your hero, collect gear, upgrade your stats and watch your character fight automatically. Push through harder enemies, bosses and new stages in this 2D incremental RPG.

apps.name: To Kill a God
apps.short_description: Craft your skill tree in this action roguelike where you must utilize skill and creativity to unleash devastating builds, all for one purpose. Break the Cycle. Kill a god.

apps.name: Toast Cat: Scratch & Win
apps.short_description: Raise a Toast Cat on your desktop that spits out all sorts of scratch cards. Whatever you're doing, it hops along with you; once it's earned enough affection, it'll pull out a scratch card just for you. No need to watch it constantly — scratch one in a spare moment and unwind.

apps.name: Tomb Guard
apps.short_description: Tomb Guard is a real-time with pause tactics game. You control a band of skeletons as they defend their homeland from the invading Fiends. Focus is key, for facing overwhelming odds is certain. Pause, strategize, and attack to protect Tombstead and defeat The Order once and for all.

apps.name: Too Many Jellies
apps.short_description: A jelly flood is coming. Build towers, aim your guns and call in missiles, Jelly Meteors and freeze beams to hold back tens of thousands of jellies. Bite-sized tower defense with 30 hand-built levels, 10 tower types and a big talent tree standing between the jelly and your town.

apps.name: TORAWASE: The Girl in the Mirror
apps.short_description: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?

apps.name: Touhou Gomoku
apps.short_description: One spell card can flip the board. As Rinnosuke of Kourindou, play Spell Card Gomoku with nine Gensokyo regulars who use cards and blunder, gloat and grumble like people. Six Incident boards, Incident Resolution, Renju, Connect6, Pente, two-player and online play, a 9-chapter story and puzzles.

apps.name: Tower of Misfits
apps.short_description: A first-person co-op roguelite from one to 6 players. Pick one of twelve misfits, each with a weapon and an ultimate of their own, and climb a tower that never ends: a new world on every floor, bosses, perks, curses, and friends to fight over the chest with.

apps.name: Towered
apps.short_description: Build smart, adapt fast and hold the Nexus in this pixel-art tower defense roguelite. Command 21 towers under a population cap, juggle gold and mana, draft augments at every level-up and spend gems on permanent power-ups across five regions.

apps.name: Toyworks
apps.short_description: A cosy first-person incremental about building a toy workshop that works for you. Drop shapes into funnels, catch the coins, and automate toy production with belts, arms and assemblers. Fill orders, unlock new rooms, and discover where your toys go.

apps.name: Trading A Giantess
apps.short_description: A unique virtual trading simulator mixed with mature giantess interactions. Master the virtual forex market, trade virtual UGTS stocks, and unlock high-quality FMV fetish mini-games. No real money involved. (18+ Adult Content)

apps.name: Treasured Carpets
apps.short_description: Run a cozy carpet shop in an Istanbul-style bazaar. Buy rugs, wash away dirt, scrub grime, dry the fibers, and restore faded patterns. Unfold your finds for customers, match their tastes, and turn careful restoration into a thriving little showroom.

apps.name: TriLeague UFO Wars
apps.short_description: Drive, fight and support your team in a multi-level sci-fi arena. Two teams compete for points while a hostile UFO fleet pressures both. Switch weapons, man turrets and use destructible cover to turn the next encounter in your favour.

apps.name: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
apps.short_description: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players

apps.name: Tropalm
apps.short_description: Tropalm is a voxel sandbox where you team up with AI companions. Speak into the mic and they answer out loud. Fell trees, build a house, go fishing and take on the island's puzzles. You can bring your companions into a friend's world too.

apps.name: Truck Job
apps.short_description: Hook up, floor it and park it perfectly. Jump trains, fly onto a departing ferry, outrun a collapsing skyway and drive into a cargo plane as it rolls. 30 handcrafted truck-and-trailer jobs against a ruthless clock.

apps.name: True Christ
apps.short_description: Experience the life of Jesus in True Christ, a faith-based simulation-adventure where you manage hunger, stamina, and health, explore biblical environments, climb, swim, collect items, use tools, and guide others in a family-friendly, story-driven journey.

apps.name: Trust Me, It's a Shortcut
apps.short_description: Buy a wreck in the Maun bazaar and drive it round the Kalahari for ten days with up to three friends. No GPS, a blank paper map, a budget that buys nothing good, and a friendly local who keeps saying: trust me, it's a shortcut.

apps.name: TunaSweeper
apps.short_description: A top-down PvE looter shooter that alternates between peaceful life at the base and dangerous expeditions. Explore for supplies, fight enemies, and decide what to take and when to return.

apps.name: Turbo Caster
apps.short_description: Turbo Caster is a survivors-like game with a circuit-style spell building system and roguelite elements. Play as a powerful wizard who uses magical runes to craft spells, discover chaotic synergies, and survive relentless waves of enemies while shaping your own arcane playstyle.

apps.name: Two Left Hands
apps.short_description: A co-op physics game about a handyman born with two left hands. Each player controls one clumsy left hand. Coordinate and catastrophize your way through wacky jobs to earn enough cash for a right-hand transplant.

apps.name: Unconventional Fantasy
apps.short_description: I have blended card game and action game genres to create this unique deck-building game. Craft your one-of-a-kind deck, encounter quirky NPCs, discover powerful cards, make choices at every turn, uncover the secrets of this world bit by bit, and embark on an adventure in this otherworld!

apps.name: Underking
apps.short_description: A first-person mining incremental game. Enter the cave to mine and extract valuable ores. Convert ores into coins and spend them on upgrades to extend your runs to reach deeper into the mountain.

apps.name: UnepicTale
apps.short_description: The dragon stole the princess, and now your path leads through dark forests and eerie swamps, teeming with fairy-tale creatures. Flip the card and prove you can handle the choice in the card game UnepicTale!

apps.name: UNK.A.N.I. VALLEY: MANA Special Operations Unit
apps.short_description: Lead a team of anomalous girls through a deck-building roguelike. Look after their daily lives at a secret facility hidden in a sealed valley, then chain their skills together in turn-based card battles against the anomalies that threaten the world.

apps.name: Unpackmania
apps.short_description: Unpackmania is an incremental card collecting game where every pack you open has the potential to make you more powerful than the last. Fight off enemies, create combos, level up, and watch your power spiral out of control.

apps.name: Up the Creek!
apps.short_description: An online co-op physics comedy for 1–4 friends. Fish through the ice by hand, keep a melting floe level, drag frozen friends out of the water and drive the catch home in an old van. The Tsar-Pike is out there.

apps.name: VANADEN
apps.short_description: Vanaden is a first-person survival horror game set in a cursed, fortress-like labyrinth. Hide from monsters, solve puzzles, and navigate shifting corridors where stealth and every decision determine your survival.

apps.name: Vanguard Armada
apps.short_description: Vanguard Armada is a turn-based starship fleet based tactics game. Build and customize a fleet of frigates, carriers, and battleships. Fight solo or co-op with up to three other players, earn persistent unlocks, and find allies in the multiplayer lobby.

apps.name: Verdant Protocol
apps.short_description: Verdant Protocol is a first-person 3D farming simulator where your crops fight back! Grow and harvest vegetables, manage soil, water, and fertilizer, and expand your greenhouse. Neglect your plants, and they'll come to hunt you. Dodge, fight, and survive!

apps.name: Very Chinese Time in My Life
apps.short_description: Learn the spoken Chinese you'll actually need on a trip to China by talking! Order food, check in at hotel, chat with locals, and be in a very Chinese time of your life.

apps.name: Vesper Drift
apps.short_description: Reclaim the five Singularities in this Asteroids-inspired roguelite. Play solo or with up to 4 players in co-op, destroy asteroids, combine weapons, fusions and passive abilities, and fight across 150 combat zones on 30 planets spread over 5 star systems.

apps.name: Vignus
apps.short_description: Ignite the everburning spark of life on a perilous alien world. VIGNUS is a top-down action RPG blending build-crafting combat with creature automation. Purify corrupted creatures, chain them into thriving production lines, defend your home, and uncover the truth of your origin — the Lifespark.

apps.name: Village Invaders
apps.short_description: A fast-paced roguelite card battler where you raid villages. Deploy your army, cast wild spells and build the perfect deck to crush every kingdom in your path.

apps.name: Virtual Fighting Championship 2
apps.short_description:
Sequal to the OG VR title VFC, VFC2 is a VR fighting game where your body is the controller. Dive into intense PvE & PvP combat. Perform fighting moves and gestures to unleash shockwaves, fireballs and ultimates. Feel like you're inside Street Fighter™ or Dragon Ball™!
Discord at

apps.name: Visual Novel: 3:17 PM
apps.short_description: Eleven-year-old Asya arrives to visit her clockmaker grandfather in Chasovets, only to discover that time has frozen at 3:17. Alongside a talking cat and a boy collecting lost minutes in a jar, climb the old tower, solve the town's mystery, and give people back their tomorrow!

apps.name: Vita: Regenesis
apps.short_description: Ten thousand years after Atria stripped the world of the Vita and Maisha. She prepares to bring her children home. Follow Iino and his companions as they fight for survival and unravel the truth behind their connection to the world and master the elements in this classic JRPG that started it all.

apps.name: Voxel Surge
apps.short_description: Pilot a custom voxel mech down a 10,000 m shaft of floating islands, alien guardians and a Titan you can climb. Pick a class, build your loadout, bust through the floor, and drag up to three friends along in split-screen or online co-op.

apps.name: We, situated in a parallel world ~ Parallel Hearts ~
apps.short_description: A school-life visual novel about childhood friends, companionship, and youth. Follow Hibiki Hinata, energetic Nanase, and a colorful group of friends through 26 chapters of laughter, chaos, travel, exams, and first love. If we had never met in another world, what would this closeness become?

apps.name: Wheels Of Steel
apps.short_description: Wheels Of Steel is a zombie-shooting roguelike with solo and online co-op play. Use gun recoil to propel your character, collect weapons, items, coins, and take a blackjack break before facing the next wave.

apps.name: Wild Myth
apps.short_description: An online co-op adventure where you and your friends hunt for proof of the world’s most dangerous myths. All for the views. Go live. Capture the chaos. Run. Cut it into viral content. Stay live. Stay alive.

apps.name: Wildermeld
apps.short_description: Hunt four dragons in a side-scrolling dark fantasy RPG. Explore a world generated anew each game, build your hero, brave dangerous dungeons, craft equipment and survive hunger, fatigue and the wilds. Earn four kingdoms' trust, with optional permadeath.

apps.name: Windwhisper Saga
apps.short_description: Set out from Windbell as an adventurer in a pixel-art, side-scrolling action RPG. Explore dungeons, face bosses, and craft gear from the materials you bring home. Get to know the locals along the way, or take on a Demon Pact when you’re ready to risk more for better loot.

apps.name: Wishfarers
apps.short_description: Wishfarers is a tactical RPG where you blow up the whole battlefield! Join a plucky band of adventurers as they chase shooting stars, face mysterious foes, and fulfill wishes both big and silly.

apps.name: Witch’s Tidy-Up
apps.short_description: Tidy a witch’s house one room at a time in this first-person organizing game. Hang up the clothes by the front door, line up scattered potion bottles on the shelves, and open new rooms as you put things away.

apps.name: Wonderland Quest
apps.short_description: Wonderland Quest is  a casual point & click adventure game. Travel across Wonderland teeming with colorful challenges, surprises and creatures, brought to life with beautiful artwork.

apps.name: WonderLang Russian
apps.short_description: Learn Russian through immersive quests, interactive dialogue, and spaced-repetition battles. Start with an optional Cyrillic module, use a graphical Russian keyboard, and help a young hero break a magical curse.

apps.name: Words In Place
apps.short_description: A spatial word puzzle: drag shaped letter pieces onto a cluttered grid and uncover hidden category words. Crossword-style intersections mean one placement can complete several words at once. Fit the pieces. Find the words. Feel the click.

apps.name: World of ALPA
apps.short_description: Explore a pixel-art world with magical Kaka companions. Build a cozy home, tend an ancient tree, and craft tools and weapons. Brave dungeons and protect each other in battle. With Alpa by your side, recover lost memories and uncover the mystery of a changing world.

apps.name: Worlds of Colors
apps.short_description: Worlds of Colors takes place in a completely different universe from ours. Explore the different worlds, created by god-like beings known as the Overseers. You play as an inhabitant of these worlds called Nivu, guided by one of the Overseers trying to save the universe from collapsing.

apps.name: WriteNor
apps.short_description: One day that never ends. One year that won't let go. WriteNor is a psychological horror about a mind that can't forgive itself — and about Nori, who isn't there anymore.

apps.name: XBPlayer
apps.short_description: Stream games from your own Xbox console or from Xbox Cloud Gaming to your Steam Deck or Linux PC, at home or away. Play with a controller or a keyboard and mouse. Pay once, no ads. Games and Game Pass are not included.

apps.name: Your Desktop Companion - Lumi
apps.short_description: Lumi is a local-first 3D AI companion that lives directly on your Windows desktop. Chat by text or voice, build a relationship over time, react to your music, and keep the core AI experience running locally on your PC.

apps.name: Your Drunken Girl
apps.short_description: Your drunken girlfriend is waiting for you right on your screen! Jump in now: take care of her, play mini-games, and unlock new spicy outfits.

apps.name: Zambala
apps.short_description:
Six warlords. One nation. No mercy.
A single player turn-based hex strategy game. Seize territory, buy loyalty, sabotage rivals, and outmanoeuvre five ruthless computer controlled factions in a brutal civil war. 

There can be no peace without war, no nation born without a scar.

apps.name: Zlin City: Diorama
apps.short_description: Build charming miniature diorama cities and train routes in a magical world inspired by the 1920s–30s. Create cozy towns, craft detailed rail networks, and relax to an original soundtrack. Inspired by real historical events and the architecture of Zlin.

apps.name: Zodiac Party
apps.short_description: Zodiac Party is a fun, casual strategy game. Choose your Zodiac Conductor and travel across China: roll the dice, invest in properties, explore cities, and face unexpected events. Play solo or with up to 4 players online or locally. Turn your friends from filthy rich to flat broke!

apps.name: Zodiac: Story of the Guardian
apps.short_description: Explore a cavernous, retro pixel asteroid to save Earth from impending disaster!

apps.name: Zombie Fun Run
apps.short_description: They're coming and we need your help! Join IRA, Crossing Guard Robot 2nd class, as he joins the Zombie Fun Run circuit and saves the day with the power of friendship and heavy artillery in this turn-based comedy RPG. The end of the world has never been so cozy!

apps.name: Zombie Recorder: Undead Divas
apps.short_description: Fight the horde—or become an undead diva. Mix gunplay, melee combat, weapon customization and over 100 character looks. Between battles, gather a dance crew, put on a simulated livestream, and frame the chaos with drone cameras and cinematic filters.

apps.name: ZombZerro999
apps.short_description: Psychological VR horror built around immersive physical interaction. Protocol 9-9-9 is compromised deep in a secret mountain facility. Science collided with occult rituals - something horrific awoke. Explore, scavenge scarce ammo, fight for survival, and uncover the truth.

apps.name: ZOO CATCHER / SUNSHARD FARM
apps.short_description: A two-game indie collection featuring ZOO CATCHER, a keyboard typing game, and SUNSHARD FARM, a farming adventure with real-time combat. Enjoy two different ways to play in one collection.

apps.name: アケノヨスガ - Twilight Loop -
apps.short_description: At 5:00 PM, she always dies. No matter how many times time rewinds, her death repeats. Relive the same day, uncover the truth, and defy her fate in this time-loop psychological horror adventure.

apps.name: ガチャプレイファイト
apps.short_description: Mash away and your moves pop out of a gacha! A free-to-play slapstick 2D fighter. Every move is pure luck, with rarities N, R, SR and SSR. Pull an ultra-rare UR for a one-hit KO that flips any match! Three modes plus online battles: party with friends or climb the global leaderboard.

apps.name: ハイシン | Haishin
apps.short_description:
One night, you casually start a livestream to show viewers around your room.
From that night on, your peaceful everyday life begins to fall apart...

apps.name: 万仙
apps.short_description: 开局即挂机，招募弟子、炼丹炼器、闯秘境占世界——一款桌面修仙放置网游。

apps.name: 不完美奇迹
apps.short_description: She has known you long, yet you meet her for the first time. A white‑haired girl smiles, confesses affection and calls you "Chen You" — yet you remember never meeting her. This meeting should’ve been the start of a romance visual novel. The sky grows restless; this world is far from "normal".

apps.name: 东方铭珠塔
apps.short_description: "Eastern Mingzhu Tower" is a multi-ending tower defense & AVG game. After the "Snow-house" is shattered by the tower's sudden emergence, you lead Ye-Luo Academy, its last guardian. Decide whether to intervene.

apps.name: 主播养成12dora - Pet Streamer 12dora
apps.short_description: This is a virtual 12dora. You can feed and bathe him to keep him healthy and in a good mood. What should you do when you're short of money? Try starting a live stream and attract viewers by showing various in-game activities. Gain more fans (and more money)!

apps.name: 九号超市避难所
apps.short_description: "No. 9  Supermarket Shelter" is an apocalyptic zombie shooter where you can switch between top-down and third-person views: rogue-like missions,  base defense tower tasks, massive multiplayer PVP, complete freedom to customize your character and outfit. Play solo or team up online with friends.

apps.name: 九州之士
apps.short_description: 战国时代背景，剧情向 RPG 为主，融合大战略玩法。战国时代九州大地列国纷争，百姓流离，原本一介庶民的你，陷入了一场巨大的阴谋中，被亲情、友情与仇恨交织裹挟，踏上了拯救自己与万民苍生的旅途。

apps.name: 云星
apps.short_description: You are the first eukaryote of Nephele! You have nothing but wisdom! Use your wisdom, to survive in such a cell-eat-cell world, and construct your cell civilization!

apps.name: 你的美腿
apps.short_description:
Pinch the stocking, pull, let go: it snaps back with a slap.
A game about legs and stockings and nothing else: touch them, tear them, get them wet.
Dozens of stockings and five pairs of shoes in the wardrobe, a water gun and a camera at hand. She gets shy, she says ouch, and slowly warms to you.

apps.name: 动物庄园 Animal Farm
apps.short_description: A free strategy card battler about resources, votes, and rules. Build a 10-card deck from five pairs, deploy animals across three districts, and use abilities, tactics, and bills to win three seats. Play against AI, find an online opponent, or join a two-player room.

apps.name: 卜卦与割草
apps.short_description: Survive spirit hordes in an ink-wash bamboo grove. Toss three coins on level-up, pick an upgrade, and evolve five skills from 64 hexagrams. Face three bosses, then see how the hexagrams you formed shape a reading on the theme you chose.

apps.name: 呱不要急
apps.short_description: Play solo against the computer in Hold Your Frogs! Dodge traffic as a frog or command the cars. Then try local two-player matches or Steam online 1v1 and 4v4. Swap sides at halftime and win with your skill build, timing and prediction.

apps.name: 夜班护士模拟器
apps.short_description: Survive 30 days in this psychological horror nursing sim. Balance routine medical tasks and time management while evading terrifying anomalies in the dark wards. Manage your dropping sanity, earn your paycheck, and escape before becoming the hospital's next permanent patient.

apps.name: 天堂世族Royal Lineage
apps.short_description: This is an online RPG featuring a retro fantasy aesthetic. Starting from Talking Island, you can play as a Knight or a Wizard, exploring villages, wilderness areas, and underground dungeons. Engage in real-time combat to hunt monsters and gather loot as you gradually develop your character.

apps.name: 寒ライバル
apps.short_description: A two-player party game featuring five winter-themed mini-games. Compete in mini-games and crush your rivals!

apps.name: 幻想灵游记
apps.short_description: The morning after a banquet, the Hakurei Shrine's donation box has vanished! Pick three companions from Gensokyo and team up your way: cover weaknesses or double down on strengths. Brave boss fights to find the missing box, and above all, enjoy a Roguelike deckbuilder full of dazzling danmaku!

apps.name: 异世界厨房:女子高中生的美食餐厅
归舟
apps.short_description: 《Returning Board》 blends naval combat, light roguelite builds, and PvE extraction. Maneuver, aim, and fire. Scavenge gear and combine weapons, attachments, and cards. Keep searching or extract with your loot? Balance combat, cargo space, and risk on every voyage.

apps.name: 怪兽对战大师
apps.short_description: Monster Battle Master is a character adventure game focused on creature collecting. You'll start by getting a unique field mouse and gradually embark on your own new adventure, challenge all the strong enemies in the region with your senior sister, and relive past memories along the journey.

apps.name: 无限数独
apps.short_description: A quiet place for Sudoku. Explore 20 variants and five difficulty levels with illustrated rules, a hands-on tutorial and hints beside the board. Save favourite puzzles, build a relay, or create and share your own puzzle files. Play solo offline with autosave.

apps.name: 林西物语 —— 放置武侠村
apps.short_description: A massive narrative idle game with extremely rich systems: farming, logging, fishing, cultivation, reincarnation, recruiting heroes, building a town, raising an army and conquering nations until you unify the continent. Includes over 300,000 words of story. Idle while reading a visual novel!

apps.name: 模联人
apps.short_description: Early this century, a school Model UN event steeped in emotional conflict and tragedy changed every participant’s life. Years later, the scattered youth reunite and seek revenge, amid fractured friendship, love, ambition and lost dreams.
publishers: ローズペタル・アトリエ

apps.name: 永禄立志伝
apps.short_description: Live the Sengoku era. Roam Japan, raise a warband, befriend warlords, and topple daimyo clans in battle. Rise from ronin to retainer, or raise your own banner and reach for the realm. A Sengoku sim of warband management, real-time battles, and living characters.

apps.name: 神雕江湖：命运推演
apps.short_description: 一款南宋末年的AI推演游戏

apps.name: 窗台世界（Sill World）
apps.short_description: A desktop wallpaper engine, a catgirl companion, and a focus tool. Grow flowers, keep fish, decorate, and press flowers, with over 1,000 collectibles. Almost everything is yours to customize. Your wallpaper, your rules!

apps.name: 茶の湯シミュレーター
apps.short_description: A quiet tearoom, but chaos in your hands! A first-person tea ceremony simulator where you brew matcha yourself—holding, tilting, and spilling. Nothing is automated, so mistakes get served as is. Score 80+ three times in a row to face a special guest. Can you score a perfect 100?
